name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Paver Lifter
tagline: PAVER LIFTER FOR RAISED PAVER FLOORING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Paver Lifter is an accessory used to easily lift pavers for removal and reinstallation of raised paver flooring. Paver lifters are manufactured from stainless steel (SUS 304), and can fit into paver gaps of ≥ 3 mm.

attributes: Twist and lift to remove pavers

Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
usage: Paver lifter for raised paver flooring installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Product must be stored in their original packing, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.
